units.source_text: 火灾发生后的第二天，我嘴里叼着烟卷，和坐在我家客厅的椅子上的学生拉卟交谈。

en.t: The day after the fire broke out, I had a cigarette in my mouth and was talking with the student Lapp, who was sitting in a chair in my living room.

units.source_text: 拉卟把右腿跷到左腿上，低垂着头看着地板发呆，那的烂嘴都快看不见了。

en.t: Lapp crossed his right leg over his left, lowered his head, and stared blankly at the floor, so that even that sore, rotten mouth of his was almost out of sight.
